# token-estimator

> Heuristic token count estimation for LLM prompts, with no tokenizer dependency.

token-estimator gives you a fast, dependency-free approximation of how many
tokens a string or chat message array will consume, without loading a real
tokenizer (tiktoken, SentencePiece, etc). It blends a chars/4 baseline with
word-boundary, whitespace-run, CJK-density, and code-density signals, then
applies a per-model-family calibration factor. Estimates are stated with an
explicit +/-15% error margin. This is for quick budget checks (fitting a
prompt into a context window, deciding whether to summarize) — not for
billing-critical accuracy. Zero runtime dependencies, strict TypeScript.

## API

- `estimateTokens(text: string, options?: EstimateOptions): TokenEstimate`
- `estimateMessages(messages: ChatMessage[], options?: EstimateOptions): TokenEstimate`
- `fitsWithin(messages: ChatMessage[], limit: number, reserve?: number, options?: EstimateOptions): FitsWithinResult`
- `ERROR_MARGIN: number` (0.15)
- `MESSAGE_OVERHEAD_TOKENS: number` (4)
- Types: `ModelFamily`, `EstimateOptions`, `TokenEstimate`, `ChatMessage`, `FitsWithinResult`

## Install

```
npm install token-estimator
```

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/FerrowAI/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
